newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in lacklustre trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Monday.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh factors. There are no (U.S.) economic indicators coming out today, so most people were hesitant to open or hold new positions," a local dealer said.
"But some people are waiting for (U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman) Alan Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins congressional testimony on Wednesday," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday and Tuesday/Wednesday were unchanged from last Friday's common 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent, respectively. Week-fixed rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from last Friday's 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-7/16 5-5/16, nine-months unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent.
